results.name: Full Planche Push Up
instructions: Begin in a full planche position with your hands placed on the floor shoulder-width apart and your body parallel to the floor, fully supported by your hands. Your legs should be extended straight behind you, and your core and glutes engaged to maintain a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a horizontal position throughout the movement.
Push through your hands to extend your arms and return to the starting planche position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining control and stability throughout the exercise.
tips: Engage your core and glutes to maintain a straight body line and prevent sagging or arching.
Ensure your hands are positioned directly under your shoulders to maintain proper form and support.
Use a non-slip surface to prevent your hands from slipping during the exercise.
This is an advanced exercise; ensure you have adequate strength and balance before attempting it.
results.description: Full Planche Push Up is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Core.

results.name: Hammer Strength MTS Iso-Lateral Decline Press Alternate Arms
instructions: Sit on the Hammer Strength MTS Iso-Lateral Decline Press, back pressed against the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing down.
Press one handle forward by extending your arm, keeping the other arm stationary.
Squeeze your chest muscles at the bottom of the movement and slowly return the handle to the starting position with control.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you press the handle and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
Keep your back pressed against the backrest throughout the exercise.
Focus on engaging your chest muscles throughout the movement.
results.description: Hammer Strength MTS Iso-Lateral Decline Press Alternate Arms is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Triceps.

results.name: Medicine Ball Hold the World Chest Press
instructions: Sit on the floor holding a medicine ball with both hands and bend your knees.
Lean your torso back and lift both feet until your shins are nearly parallel to the floor.
Extend your arms straight upward, holding the ball over your head while balancing on your hips.
Hold the position for the desired duration, then lower the ball and your feet with control.
tips: Keep your chest lifted without collapsing backward.
Brace your core to keep your torso and legs steady.
Keep your arms straight and the ball aligned with your shoulders.
Inhale and exhale steadily without holding your breath.
results.description: Medicine Ball Hold the World Chest Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Shoulders, Quadriceps.

results.name: Incline Bench Cable Fly
instructions: Set an incline bench between two cable machines with the pulleys positioned at the middle setting. Lie back on the bench with your feet flat on the floor. Grasp a handle in each hand, with your palms facing up and your arms extended to your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your back pressed firmly against the bench.
Raise the handles opposite your chest in a wide arc, until your arms are level with your chest, squeezing your chest muscles at the top of the movement.
Lower the handles back the starting position in a controlled manner. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout the exercise to avoid straining your joints.
Keep your back and head pressed firmly against the bench.
Exhale as you bring the handles up and inhale as you lower them down.
results.description: Incline Bench Cable Fly is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Biceps.

results.name: Incline Push-Up (On Box)
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box and place your hands on top, close to the edge, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Step your feet back to extend your legs behind you, forming a straight line from your head to your heels.
Engage your core and keep your body straight. Lower your chest towards the box by bending your elbows, keeping them at a 45-degree angle to your body.
Lower yourself until your chest is close to the box, then push through your hands to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you push up and inhale as you lower yourself down.
Use a sturdy box or bench that can support your weight without moving.
Keep your core engaged to maintain a straight body line and avoid sagging your hips.
results.description: Incline Push-Up (On Box) is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Shoulders, Core.
